correctness.rationale: Right multiplication by the transposition of i and j swaps the two images, flips the inversion sign, and changes the cycle count by plus or minus one according to whether i and j are in the same cycle. Conditioning on their two images gives the exact same-cycle probabilities 0, 1, or 1/2 in the three completion classes, which yields the gap coefficient. Summation produces the total covariance; the correlation follows from the classical marginal variances, and differentiation of the Mallows exponential family gives the response identity. Fresh exhaustive recomputation through n=7 and the package checker through n=8 agree exactly.

value.rationale: Cycle structure and inversion bias are central observables of the Mallows model. The exact local contribution by positional gap and its finite-n aggregate give a natural first-order bridge between them that is not supplied by marginal or asymptotic cycle results.
residual_risks: Older enumerative permutation literature may encode the same mixed first moment under a different bivariate generating function.

final_claim: For a uniform permutation, the covariance between total cycle count and the ordinary inversion indicator at positions i<j is exactly minus (2(j-i)-1)/(2n(n-1)); summing gives covariance with total inversion number minus (2n-1)/12 and the corresponding exact Mallows linear response at q=1.
limitations: The result is a first-order statement at the uniform point q=1 and does not determine the full expected-cycle function for q away from one.
The local statistic is ordinary one-line inversion, not cycle-word inversion.
Older enumerative permutation literature may encode the same mixed first moment under a different bivariate generating function.
